perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

enhanced.name: Shoot to Loot
enhanced.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves. Increases range.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

enhanced.name: Wellspring
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.description: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

enhanced.name: Surplus
enhanced.description: Substantially increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.description: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

enhanced.name: Shot Swap
enhanced.description: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at an additionally improved rate.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: Stats for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Perfect Float
enhanced.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne accuracy and reduces flinch until you are out of combat for an extended duration.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.description: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

enhanced.name: Archer's Tempo
enhanced.description: Draw time substantially decreases after every precision hit for a longer duration.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.description: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

enhanced.name: Eye of the Storm
enhanced.description: This weapon has more improved accuracy and handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.description: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

enhanced.name: Gutshot Straight
enhanced.description: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage but decreases target acquisition slightly.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

enhanced.name: Rampage
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant increased damage for an improved duration. Stacks 3 times.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
